purpose: Quotes and candidates must match existing provider request fields. This is source contract evidence, not guest/cloud qualification.

aws.subnet: configured subnet_id, optionally approved subnet_id extra
aws.public_ip: No AssociatePublicIpAddress request field; derive from selected subnet MapPublicIpOnLaunch; no unsupported override

root_disk.when_omitted: Do not invent gp3/size values. Resolve actual AMI/API inheritance or emit explicit supported extras before quoting.
root_disk.gp3_throughput_unit: MiB/s integer request; cost/hardware conversions retain fractional precision

metadata_required: exact billing product and cost horizon

binding_safety.configuration: Read pinned actual provider TOML; verify SHA256 before using its target/auth facts
binding_safety.region: Must equal catalog/runtime declared region, or reject before launch
binding_safety.credentials: Use same supported static credentials/session token for Rust read-only SDK account verification; no unrelated parent ambient default chain
binding_safety.account: STS account must equal binding and current admin account constraint
binding_safety.unsupported_role_context: Reject explicitly until child allowlist/identity equivalence is implemented and qualified

quote_rules: disk tier follows provisioned size and selected account type
public IP billed only when selected
Windows compute meter must not double-count licensing
ephemeral root must fit supported VM cache/resource disk and cannot be billed as ordinary managed root
azure.unknown_storage_account_type: upstream normalizes to Standard_LRS; Outrider must reject unknown requested class instead of silently billing another class

gcp.flavor: exact machine type in configured zone
gcp.network_id_extra: Parsed into RunnerSpec but ignored by zonal Create, which uses g.cfg.NetworkID. Quote and validate actual configured network.
gcp.public_ip: Only central external_ip_access config controls AccessConfigs; false removes external IP

root_disk.source_snapshot: clears SourceImage; unsupported if no matching snapshot price/image facts

gcp.unsupported_mutations: Do not invent guest accelerator or extra local-disk attachment extras absent from the selected provider path; reject unsupported requirements explicitly

all_clouds.profile_to_child: Resolve exact candidate flavor/image/disk and permitted market; preserve original controller/pool and bootstrap registration metadata.
all_clouds.hard_limits: Final catalog selection and every initial purchasing tier must satisfy current limits; unknown hardware cannot satisfy a requirement.
